capture.coverage: Official SDK native harness JSONL steps with recorded timestamps and user/assistant text, safe user-envelope projection, frozen App/CLI/IDE brain roots and root-namespaced conversation IDs. Full transcript preferred; message IDs derived from step positions.

Every native step retained as a marker, including tool arguments/results, reasoning, opaque media and compact truncation. No tool-call joins, measured usage, model, cwd, parent relationships, native resume or live execution inferred. SDK-native fixtures establish parsing; actual App/CLI writer captures remain unverified. New same-timestamp message suffixes behind truncated/nonterminal steps are deferred until complete; native step-index order is preserved without changing recorded timestamps.
